mapper.insert:
insert into order_detail (name, order_id, dish_id, setmeal_id, dish_flavor, number, amount, pic) values
(#{od.name},#{od.orderId},#{od.dishId},#{od.setmealId},#{od.dishFlavor}, #{od.number},#{od.amount},#{od.pic})
mapper.select: SELECT od.id, od.name, od.order_id, od.dish_id, od.setmeal_id, od.dish_flavor, od.number, od.amount, COALESCE(d.image, od.pic) AS pic FROM order_detail od LEFT JOIN dish d ON od.dish_id = d.id WHERE od.order_id = #{orderId}
